Welcome to Webitoo Lab

An interactive 3D lab: discover the force between two parallel wires that carry currents.

F = μ₀ I₁ I₂ L / (2π d)
μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T·m/A
F = 0 N
No force (currents are off)
Field BCurrent IForce FNeutral point
Free controls

Length of each wire L = 0.25 m (fixed). The swing of the wires is exaggerated so you can see it.
